title: Meta signs $12B five-year capacity deal with Nebius

sources.quote: Under the five-year agreement, Nebius will provide $12 billion of dedicated capacity across multiple locations, based on one of the first large-scale deployments of the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform.

explain: Meta agreed to buy $12 billion of dedicated AI computing capacity from Nebius over five years, running on Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin chips.
